Added 24 inline theme-safe SVG figures (currentColor strokes/text, soft #60a5fa/#f59e0b region fills at 0.30 opacity, Inter labels, role=img + aria-label, no external refs) generated programmatically from each problems own numbers. Covers all 20 bank problems, 3 teach walks and the opener. No question text, solutions, guided_steps, hints, misconceptions or expects were changed; original display text preserved byte-for-byte after each figure.
